title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, §94G, as amended by St. 198l, c. 375 and Company's tariff M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of February through April, 1995. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company; and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to qualifying facilities for purchases of power, pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules establshed in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 20l and 2l0 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
